text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Are you resuming your training today, Ms. 
Gentile? Were you able to get plenty of 
rest over the break?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. On my way back from shopping, I 
stopped by the sporting goods store I 
frequent, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The new training machine had just the 
right amount of resistance, so I was able 
to refresh myself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The floor creaked a bit when I put some 
muscle into it, but the machine held up 
fine. It looks like we can count on its 
durability."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd like to try that too. I can't 
wait for it to be introduced to the 
academy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna chatted merrily with her 
roommate while getting ready in the 
morning. It seemed she had gotten plenty 
of rest.
